title: 911 — Emergency
subtitle: Police, fire, ambulance or immediate danger
description: For an immediate life-threatening emergency or when police, fire or ambulance assistance is needed.

title: 988 — Mental Health Crisis
subtitle: Call or text 988, 24/7
description: Free, confidential crisis support by phone or text.

title: 211 Oklahoma / HeartLine
subtitle: Free 24/7 connection to local services
description: Ask for shelter, food, housing, health care, child care, utility assistance, employment and other human services.

title: Homeless Alliance — WestTown
subtitle: Day shelter, housing navigation and coordinated services
description: Resource Center: Mon–Fri, 9:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m. Day Shelter: 7:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. daily. Winter Shelter: 3:00 p.m.–7:00 a.m., Nov. 1–Mar. 31. Call for housing assessment if sleeping outside, in a car or shelter.

title: City Care — OKC Night Shelter
subtitle: Overnight shelter and housing support
address: 532 N. Villa Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73107
description: Night shelter generally 6:00 p.m.–7:00 a.m.; family hours listed by City Care are 4:30 p.m.–8:00 a.m. Housing line: 405-652-1112.

title: City Rescue Mission
subtitle: 24/7 shelter and supportive programs
address: 800 W. California Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73106
description: Emergency shelter and supportive programs for single men, single women and families with children.

title: Sanctuary Women’s Development Center
subtitle: Day services for women
description: Day services listed by the City of Oklahoma City for women experiencing homelessness.

title: Pivot
subtitle: Youth homelessness services
description: Youth-specific shelter and support resources are listed by Key to Home.

title: Sisu Youth Services
subtitle: Youth homelessness services
description: Youth-specific shelter and support resources are listed by Key to Home.

title: YWCA Oklahoma City
subtitle: Domestic violence shelter/support
description: Domestic violence overnight shelter listed by the City of Oklahoma City. If immediate danger, call 911.

title: Palomar
subtitle: Family justice and domestic violence support
address: 1140 N. Hudson Ave, Oklahoma City, OK
description: Family justice center providing support for survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, stalking, and human trafficking. Call to learn about services and access.

title: SNAP — Oklahoma Human Services
subtitle: Apply for food benefits online
description: Apply, upload documents and check case status through OKDHSLIVE. SNAP benefits are loaded to an EBT card when approved.

title: Oklahoma WIC
subtitle: Pregnancy, postpartum, infants and children under 5
description: Online enrollment request and clinic selection are available. WIC serves eligible pregnant/breastfeeding/postpartum women, infants and children under age 5.

title: Skyline Urban Outreach
subtitle: Food Resource Center and basic-needs support
description: Food Resource Center and other basic-needs services. Confirm current pantry hours before traveling.

title: Variety Care
subtitle: Community health centers and integrated care
description: Community health centers with primary care and additional services at multiple OKC-area locations. Ask about uninsured/sliding-fee options and the closest site.

title: Mental Health Association Oklahoma
subtitle: Community mental-health assistance
description: OKC lists this community assistance hotline as a homelessness/mental-health support resource; listed hours are 8:30 a.m.–8 p.m. Monday–Friday.

title: EMBARK
subtitle: OKC bus, RAPID and streetcar transit
description: Trip planning, bus-pass questions, reduced-fare applications and service information. Customer-care phone support is listed Monday–Friday 7:30 a.m.–8 p.m. and Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

title: MOE — Mobile Outreach & Engagement
subtitle: Free rides to essential services
description: City Care’s Mobile Outreach & Engagement shuttle provides complimentary transportation to essential services and partner providers. Check current routes before traveling.

title: Oklahoma Works
subtitle: Jobs, resumes, interviews and career training
description: Workforce services include job search, resume/application help, interview preparation, career education and training resources.

title: Legal Aid Services of Oklahoma
subtitle: Free legal-help intake and referrals
description: Free legal-help resources covering housing, eviction, family law, domestic violence, health law, employment and other issues. Phone intake listed Monday–Thursday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.

title: OCU Housing Eviction Legal Assistance Program
subtitle: Tenant legal advice; Oklahoma County eviction representation
address: 800 N. Harvey Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73102
description: Provides legal advice to tenants statewide and court representation for evictions in Oklahoma and Cleveland counties, subject to program rules.

title: OKC Action Center
subtitle: Request city/outreach assistance
description: Request street outreach or report a city service concern. OKC also lists text support at 405-252-1053.

title: ID & Document Recovery
subtitle: Start replacing lost identification/documents
description: The app routes document-recovery needs to 211 and local partner agencies rather than publishing a single office that may not fit the person’s situation.

title: Metro Library System
subtitle: Free Wi‑Fi, computers and document services
description: Public libraries can provide internet access, computers and printing/scanning services. Useful for benefit applications, housing applications and job searches.

title: Jesus House
subtitle: Residential recovery support
address: 1335 W. Sheridan Ave, Oklahoma City, OK
description: Residential recovery program listed by the City of Oklahoma City.

title: Delaware County Community Partnership FRC
subtitle: Family resource center serving Delaware County
description: Family resource center providing family support, connections and local resources in Delaware County.

title: LIFT Community Action Agency FRC
subtitle: Family resource center in southeastern Oklahoma
description: Family resource center operated by LIFT Community Action Agency; connects families with direct supports and community resources.

title: Great Plains Youth & Family Services, Inc. FRC
subtitle: Family resource center in southwest Oklahoma
description: Family resource center serving families through a youth and family services organization.
coverage: Beckham, Greer, Kiowa, Washita, Harmon, Jackson and Tillman counties

title: Greater New Zion Hope Center FRC
subtitle: Family and community support center
description: Family resource center supported through the Potts Family Foundation network. Contact the center for current family-support offerings.

title: Legacy Parenting Center FRC
subtitle: Pregnancy through early childhood family support
description: Free parent education, mentoring, tangible resources and connections for families from pregnancy through age five.
coverage: Pottawatomie and Seminole counties and surrounding communities

title: Center for Children and Families FRC
subtitle: Family support and resource center
description: Family resource center operated by Center for Children and Families, providing family support and connections in the Norman area.

title: Northern Oklahoma Youth Services FRC
subtitle: Family and youth resource center
description: Family resource center operated by Northern Oklahoma Youth Services, connecting families and youth to local supports.
address: 2203 N Ash St, Ponca City, OK 74601

title: Our Daily Bread Food & Resource Center FRC
subtitle: Food, resource navigation and family support
description: Food and resource center in Stillwater with family-resource programming and connections to community supports.

title: Pathways to a Healthier You Family Resource Center
subtitle: Family support and health-resource connections
description: Family resource center providing coordinated support and connections to services.

title: The Parent Child Center of Tulsa FRC
subtitle: Parent, child and family support
description: Family resource center providing parent and child supports and connections to community resources.

title: Parent Promise
subtitle: Parent education, home visiting, and family support
description: Family-focused nonprofit offering parent education and home-visiting support, including Children First and services designed to strengthen families and support healthy child development. Contact Parent Promise to ask about program eligibility and referrals.
address: 4323 NW 63rd St, Suite 200, Oklahoma City, OK 73116

title: Tri-County Family Resource Center
subtitle: Resource navigation and family stabilization
description: Connects people and families with community resources, direct services and support to strengthen stability and self-reliance.
coverage: Tri-county / rural family resource service area

title: Western Plains Youth & Family Services FRC
subtitle: Youth and family services in northwest Oklahoma
description: Family resource center connected to Western Plains Youth & Family Services, with family and youth supports and community connections.
coverage: Beaver, Dewey, Ellis, Harper, Texas, Cimarron and Woodward counties

title: Great Plains Family YMCA Family Resource Center
subtitle: Family resource center in Weatherford
description: Family Resource Center at the Great Plains Family YMCA strengthens families, supports parents and supports students.

title: Lowrey Family Resource Center
subtitle: Family resource center
description: Family resource center included in the Potts Family Foundation's statewide FRC roster. Check the center's current contact information before visiting.

title: RestoreOKC Family Resource Center
subtitle: Whole-family support in Northeast Oklahoma City
description: Place-based family support connecting health, housing, education and employment resources to help families move from crisis toward stability and opportunity.

title: Oklahoma 2-1-1
subtitle: Statewide service navigation
description: Free connection to local services including housing, food, health care, child care, utilities, employment and other human services.

title: Oklahoma Human Services — Benefits & Applications
subtitle: SNAP, TANF, child care and energy assistance
description: Central entry point for many Oklahoma Human Services benefits. Online applications and local office help are available.

title: Oklahoma Human Services — Child Care Subsidy
subtitle: Help paying for licensed child care
description: Helps eligible families pay for participating licensed child care while a parent works, trains or attends education.

title: parentPRO
subtitle: Free voluntary home-visiting connection
description: Connects pregnant families and parents of children from birth to five with local home-visiting programs and other family supports.

title: SoonerCare
subtitle: Oklahoma Medicaid and health coverage
description: Apply for Oklahoma health coverage for eligible children, pregnant people, adults and other qualifying groups; some populations apply through Oklahoma Human Services.

title: SoonerStart Early Intervention
subtitle: Early intervention for children birth to 3
description: Family-centered early intervention for infants and toddlers with developmental delays or disabilities. There is no direct cost to families.

title: Oklahoma Human Services — Developmental Disabilities Services
subtitle: Supports for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities
description: Services include case management, employment and day services, respite, home and community supports and Medicaid waiver programs for eligible Oklahomans.

title: Oklahoma Family Network
subtitle: Family-to-family support and resource navigation
description: Statewide family support and mentorship for families raising children with special health care needs or disabilities, including parent-to-parent support and resource navigation.

title: Oklahoma Parents Center
subtitle: Special education parent support
description: Statewide parent training and information for families of children and young adults with disabilities, including individualized assistance, training and advocacy support.

title: Sooner SUCCESS
subtitle: Care coordination and family navigation
description: Promotes coordinated health, social and educational services for Oklahoma children and youth with special health care needs through navigation, coordination and family/community linkages.

title: Oklahoma Systems of Care
subtitle: Family-driven behavioral health and service coordination
description: Statewide collaborative network supporting children, youth and young adults through community-based, trauma-informed, culturally responsive, youth-guided and family-driven services.

title: Systems of Care — Wraparound & Coordinated Services
subtitle: Individualized family-centered care coordination
description: Wraparound helps families build an individualized plan of care with a team and connect to community resources and supports.

title: Systems of Care — School-Based Services
subtitle: Mental health and family support through schools
description: School-based initiatives connect youth and families with emotional support and services through local schools and community providers.

title: Oklahoma Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics
subtitle: Integrated behavioral health, crisis, housing and employment supports
description: CCBHCs provide a broad behavioral health service model that includes care coordination, outreach, integrated care, peer/family support, housing and employment services.

title: 988 Mental Health Lifeline
subtitle: Call or text 988 for crisis support
description: Connects people experiencing a mental health or emotional crisis with trained crisis professionals.

title: OK I'm Ready
subtitle: Substance use treatment information and connections
description: Oklahoma's state resource for information about substance use disorder treatment and recovery options.

title: OK SNAP Works
subtitle: Free employment and training for eligible SNAP recipients
description: Connects eligible SNAP participants to job skills training, education, resume and interview help and possible support with child care, transportation, supplies and fees.

title: McKinney-Vento Homeless Education Assistance
subtitle: School rights and support for students experiencing homelessness
description: Every Oklahoma public school district designates a McKinney-Vento liaison to help students and families with identification, enrollment, school stability, transportation, educational services and community referrals.

title: Oklahoma Human Services — Family-Centered Services
subtitle: Prevention support for families involved with child welfare
description: Voluntary services designed to help families maintain children safely at home and connect with community supports before situations escalate to foster care or court involvement.

title: Oklahoma Children's Services
subtitle: Home- and community-based child welfare prevention services
description: Comprehensive Home-Based Services, Parent Aide Services and Title IV-E prevention services for families involved with child welfare or at risk of foster care entry.

title: Oklahoma Successful Adulthood Program
subtitle: Transition support for youth in and from foster care
description: Supports youth ages 16-21 in foster care or transitioning from custody with planning, permanent connections, life skills, education and preparation for independent adulthood.

title: Oklahoma Child Support Services
subtitle: Apply for child support services
description: Helps families establish and manage child support services. Applications can be completed online through OKBenefits.

title: Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF)
subtitle: Cash assistance and work-support program
description: For qualifying families with minor children; may include cash assistance, employment-related supports and other benefits.

title: LIHEAP — Energy Assistance
subtitle: Help with home energy bills
description: Federal energy assistance for income-eligible households. Oklahoma Human Services opens scheduled application periods and also provides crisis assistance subject to program rules and funding.

title: Foster Care & Adoption Family Hotline
subtitle: Information for foster and adoptive families
description: Statewide hotline for people interested in becoming foster or adoptive parents and for related family support information.

title: Post Adoption Services
subtitle: Support for adoptive families
description: Support intended to help secure and sustain safe, permanent adoptive families, including families caring for children with special needs.

title: Oklahoma Family Support Network
subtitle: Statewide family resource center network
description: Oklahoma's Family Resource Center and family-support network, connected to the National Family Support Network and focused on high-quality family strengthening, parent leadership and coordinated supports.

title: Youth & Family Resource Center of Shawnee
subtitle: Youth, family and community support
description: Provides family and youth services, counseling, community programs and connections to support in the Shawnee area.
coverage: Pottawatomie, Lincoln and surrounding rural communities

title: Okmulgee County Family Resource Center
subtitle: Family, domestic violence and child advocacy support
description: Community-based nonprofit serving families, survivors of domestic violence or sexual assault, and children involved with the juvenile court system.
coverage: Okmulgee, Creek and Okfuskee counties and Creek Nation tribal service area

title: Oklahoma State University Family Resource Center
subtitle: Family and resident support in Stillwater
description: Provides year-round programs and services for residents of OSU university housing, including food, supplies, family activities, youth and family programs and connections to community resources.
coverage: OSU university housing communities in Stillwater

title: Family Resource Center of Seminole County
subtitle: Family and domestic violence resource
description: Family resource center identified in Oklahoma's certified domestic violence and sexual assault program listings. Confirm current services and intake before traveling.

title: Upward Transitions
subtitle: Housing stability, rent and utility assistance, transportation, and identification documents
address: 1134 W. Main Street, Oklahoma City, OK 73106
description: Helps people experiencing housing instability through emergency relief and stabilization services, including rent or utility assistance for eligible households, transportation support, and birth certificates or state IDs. Call ahead to ask about current program availability and screening.

title: Second Chances Thrift Store
subtitle: Thrift store supporting community outreach and reentry assistance
address: 2605 N. MacArthur Blvd, Oklahoma City, OK 73127
description: Thrift store proceeds support outreach and practical assistance such as food, identification, bus passes, housing connections, and other resources. Call ahead to confirm current store hours and available assistance.

title: ReMerge
subtitle: Treatment and support for mothers involved in the criminal legal system
address: 823 N. Villa Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73107
description: A community-based alternative-to-incarceration program for eligible mothers, combining treatment and support services to help families build stability. Contact ReMerge directly to ask about eligibility, referrals, and current program availability.

title: Diversion Hub
subtitle: Justice navigation and community support
description: Provides free navigation and support for people involved in the justice system, helping connect individuals and families with treatment, housing, health, and community services. OKC intake is listed Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–noon; call to confirm eligibility and next steps. The organization warns that it does not charge for its services.

title: Joe's Addiction
subtitle: Day shelter, coffee shop, food, clothing, and community support
description: Community day shelter and outreach space offering coffee, food, clothing, and practical support in a welcoming environment. Listed hours vary by day; call or check the website before visiting.

title: Positive Tomorrows
subtitle: School and family support for families experiencing homelessness
description: Provides education and family support for children and families experiencing homelessness, including support with housing stability, employment, transportation, meals, and basic needs. No street address or location is displayed in this directory for privacy.

title: A Chance to Change
subtitle: Mental health counseling, addiction recovery, and family support
address: 2113 W. Britton Rd, Oklahoma City, OK 73120
description: Provides outpatient counseling and education for mental health concerns, substance use and addiction, trauma-related concerns, and family challenges. Ask about services, insurance or Medicaid acceptance, and financial assistance options.
